name: Continuum Subtraction
summary: Subtracts the broadband continuum from narrowband images with an estimated factor, and blends the result into RGB, ported from the Continuum Subtraction Siril script.
description: AfterNight port of Narrowband Continuum Subtraction for Siril by Adrian Knagg-Baugh and Dave Lindner. Continuum Subtraction removes the broadband continuum from a linear narrowband image, emission - c x continuum, estimating c by minimizing the result's average absolute deviation over a painted region with a coarse scan, a fine scan and a smooth-V fit, or taking c from a slider. Continuum Blend adds a continuum-subtracted line into a linear RGB image, median-centred, with a strength and per-channel weights. AfterNight port by Ezequiel Ruiz.
author: Adrian Knagg-Baugh and Dave Lindner (original) / Ezequiel Ruiz (port)
attribution: AfterNight port of Narrowband Continuum Subtraction for Siril by Adrian Knagg-Baugh and Dave Lindner. AfterNight port by Ezequiel Ruiz.
